searches: Nath full report: cultural sequence, construction chapters and repeated radiometric table; Dikshit later table; Cambridge dissertation chronology review; recent Rakhigarhi excavation and cemetery dating papers; Bayesian and layout-start searches.

disagreements.text: The report uses both IA/IB and an alternative numbered structural sequence. The later review states that new early dates lack the stratigraphic profiles and cultural-material publication needed to assess establishment and abandonment.
